input_action.name: ResourceDisplayHotkey
input_action.description: Press this button to open the AMU resource display, an overview over all resources including custom ones created with the AMU framework.

input_action.name: TracingWindowHotkey
input_action.description: Press this button to open the AMU tracing window, an overview over all debug flags for AMU-managed structures (such as ManagedWorldInfo- and ManagedFaction-based classes).

input_action.name: FactionRelationsWindowHotkey
input_action.description: Press this button to open the AMU faction relations window, an overview over all factions and what relations they have to each other. Extremely useful for games with random factions.

input_action.name: ObjectContentDisplayWindowHotkey
input_action.display_name: Open/Close AMU Object Content Display Window
input_action.description: Press this button to open the AMU OCD window. This UI allows the user to navigate through, inspect and manipulate aspects of the current game object content itself.

input_action.name: ObjectContentDisplayClearSearchText
input_action.display_name: Clear and edit Object Content Display Search Textbox
input_action.description: Press this button to clear all text from the OCD search textbox, allowing one to quickly clear it after searching and selecting something as well as entering new text.

input_action.name: ObjectContentDisplayShowOnScreenDisplay
input_action.display_name: Show/Hide Object Content Display - On Screen Display
input_action.description: The OCD allows (with middle mouse click) to add and remove a value to the OSD. The OSD itself can be shown and hidden with this hotkey. The combination of OCD / OSD can be used to monitor certain important values ingame at one glance.

input_action.name: ObjectContentDisplayOnScreenDisplayEditorHotkey
input_action.display_name: Show/Hide Object Content Display - On Screen Display Editor
input_action.description: This allows for editing the name, disabling or removing items from the OCD /OSD.
